name: Nelson Marlborough Institute of Technology (NMIT)
educationLevels: Bachelors, Certificate, Diploma, Graduate Certificate, Graduate Diploma, Masters, Pathway
description: Nelson Marlborough Institute of Technology (NMIT) is the largest provider of tertiary education in the beautiful top of the South Island of New Zealand, with a diverse range of programmes to choose from, across our campuses in Nelson and Marlborough. For over 100 years, it has been providing high quality tertiary education for students. Its internationally talented staffs are entirely dedicated to giving the real world skills and a recognized qualification to embark on the career the students deserve.  NMIT offers a diverse range of qualifications from certificate through to masters level in a vast range of areas including applied management, aviation engineering, information technology, marine science and viticulture & winemaking.
